answer: Threshold endorsement of device integrity requires a quorum of attestation services to agree that a device is unmodified, and the fable of the design is that each service checks a different layer of the device. The lotus of the protocol is that the endorsement is only valid when enough services agree, so one compromised service cannot bless a rooted device. A Sybil farm running emulators cannot pass because the quorum checks hardware properties, and the lagoon of the endorsement is bound to the device's unique keys.
